description:
Retrieve a list of featureRolloutPolicy objects.

TIP: Lists feature rollout policies. These enable staged rollout of Entra ID features (like passwordHashSync, seamlessSSO, passthroughAuthentication) to specific groups before tenant-wide enablement. Each has displayName, feature, isEnabled, and isAppliedToOrganization.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-feature-rollout-policies
